goal: Prevent malicious or malformed Tor control responses from injecting commands into the Tor daemon
Ensure nodes do not cache corrupted private keys or advertise invalid onion addresses
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified by building and testing on FreeBSD (winterrdog)
Approved after addressing argument injection in cached keys (jeanpablojp)
Approved with minor non-blocking cleanup suggestions open (vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it closes a command injection flaw exploitable by unprivileged local processes
Prevents attackers from spoofing control replies to shut down Tor or alter connection flags
Protects onion service availability and keeps invalid service addresses off the network
